title: How Tibo grew five SaaS products from $125k to $700k+ MRR in 2025
summary: Tibo's 2025 review of his multi-product portfolio, which grew 5.6x to $700k+ MRR. Product by product, he draws lessons on building tailwind businesses, turning customers into a growth loop, cutting losers, finding co-founders, and building a real audience over vanity followers.

principles.text: Build a 'tailwind business' that gets better every time the underlying AI/tech improves, instead of fearing new models.
principles.quote: Revid is a “Tailwind business” meaning it will get better, sharper when a new + better AI model works in the background.

principles.text: Don't just wrap APIs: build workflows users need, focus on quality niches, and add platform integrations that create switching costs.
principles.quote: We're not just wrapping AI APIs - we built workflows users actually need (without playing with AI on their own)

principles.text: Make customers an active part of your growth loop; network effects (like a backlink exchange pool) improve retention.
principles.quote: “How can I make my customers an active part of my growth journey? Can this help them too?”

principles.text: Distribute revenue across several products so no single product carries the business; it changes how you take risks.
principles.quote: Revenue became genuinely distributed for the first time. I'm no longer dependent on a single product carrying everything.

principles.text: If a product stagnates and you can't crack growth, hand it to someone who can focus on it instead of holding on.
principles.quote: Sometimes the best move is giving a great product to someone who can focus on it properly.

principles.text: The right co-founder fills the skill gaps you lack; a rebuild and relaunch with better storytelling unstuck a $1k MRR product.
principles.quote: The right co-founder changes everything. Rob brought the missing piece I couldn't provide alone.
